standard_prerequisites: the completion functor section: morphisms with image in T factor through X_{/T}-related fibre products (Formal Spaces, Section formal-spaces-section-completion)
the infinitesimal criterion for etaleness (More on Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-more-morphisms-lemma-check-smoothness-on-infinitesimal-nbhds)
an etale monomorphism of algebraic spaces is an open immersion (Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-etale-universally-injective-open)
core_obligations: Prove that if X is locally Noetherian, g : Z -> Y is a monomorphism locally of finite type, f|_{X minus T} factors through g, and the formal completion f_{/T} : X_{/T} -> Y factors through g, then f : X -> Y factors through g
proof_roadmap: Form the fibre product E = X x_Y Z; the assumptions make both the open part X minus T and every part of X lying over T factor through E, so the projection E -> X is etale at points over T by the infinitesimal criterion.
The projection E -> X is a monomorphism (base change of g) which is etale at every point, hence an open immersion.
Since the open part and the part over T together cover |X|, the open immersion E -> X is surjective on underlying topological spaces, hence E = X and f factors through g.
difficulty_reason: H3: a factorization argument combining the infinitesimal etaleness criterion with the identification of etale monomorphisms as open immersions.
